diagnosis: Retaining every proof-only RUP prefix fixed corpus 031's disappearing implied-unit reason, but changed the clause population seen by later witnessless DSR additions. RAT is not monotone under adding implied clauses: each retained clause containing the negated pivot creates another resolvent obligation, so a later clause that was RAT in the kernel formula can cease to be RAT in the checker formula.
